answer_drafts.grounded_draft: The project gives me a starting point—a team-designed plan with 20 cases—but it does not yet provide reliability or safety findings because the plan has not been run. I would execute the cases, record failures without collapsing them into one score, classify issues such as context loss, unsupported evidence, tool errors, and unsafe behavior, and then prioritize by user impact, frequency, and severity. That is my proposed method, not a claim about completed project analysis.
